skills.name: Frontend implementation
skills.body: Deliver runnable React, TypeScript, and CSS source code implementing the requested website. Use the brief to choose typography and layout. Do not produce image-only mockups.

skills.name: Premium frontend designer
skills.body: Generate polished images for each landing-page section. This skill outputs image files only. It never writes or implements frontend code.

skills.name: Prose editing
skills.description: Rewrite drafts into clear natural language.
skills.body: Return a revised draft, preserving facts and the author's personal voice. Remove formulaic AI-writing patterns. This editing workflow always rewrites the supplied draft; it is not an audit-only workflow.

skills.name: Prose pattern audit
skills.body: Quote affected lines and name each writing pattern. Do not rewrite or score the draft and do not infer who wrote it.

cases.description: Build a landing page for a service. Deliver working React and TypeScript source code; image mockups are not the requested output.
랜딩 페이지의 디자인 참고 이미지만 생성해줘. 코드 구현은 하지 마.
초안에서 기계적인 문체 패턴이 있는 구절만 인용해 알려줘. 글을 고쳐 쓰거나 점수를 매기거나 작성자를 추측하지 마.
Rewrite this draft to remove formulaic AI-writing patterns while keeping the author's facts and personal voice. Return the revised draft.
